text:
incident-bot: :warning: ALERT: spike in model-runtime-prod 5xx errors and request timeouts observed on cluster 'runner-7' (5xx ~22% over 90s). Rule: runtime.error_rate > 5% for 1m. Sample attached: repeated SIGSEGV and OOM kills in model_worker; some cores produced.

Maya Patel: paging oncall now. Rafael, you available to take lead?

Rafael SRE: I'm up. Pulling logs and recent kernel rings.

obs-bot: logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/model-runtime/runner-7/1945684300 (past 2h). metrics: https://metrics/ui/d/runtimes/model-runtime-prod?panelId=8

Sania Iqbal: Stack traces show `free()` on already-freed pointer in kv_cache eviction path, then SIGSEGV at runtime cleanup. GPU mem climbs to ~97% before OOM. A recent change touched eviction policy (PR #1178).

Maya Patel: Which models are hitting this? Any single tenant causing traffic spike?

Omar L.: Mostly rwx-13b and rwx-14b-ops; header shows heavy batched requests from customer ZephyrCorp (x-customer-id=ZEPHYR). Batch sizes spiking to 64+ with long context windows.

Tina P.: Short-term: force-route ZephyrCorp to rwx-7b-quantized and enforce max_batch 16 at gateway. I'm preparing the command.

Maya Patel: Execute now.

Tina P.: Running gateway override:
```bash
# transparently downgrade ZephyrCorp traffic to 7b quant fallback and cap batch size
redwoodctl routes modify --match "headers.x-customer-id=ZEPHYR" --model rwx-7b-quant --add-param "max_batch=16"
```

deploy-bot: route update accepted; propagation ~15s.

Rafael SRE: While that rolls, I'll cordon and drain affected runner-7 hosts to prevent further core churn. Marking runner-7-1 for reboot.

Maya Patel: Before restart, grab core and heap: please cp /var/crash/* to incident artifact bucket and enable extended debug env on the pod.

Sania Iqbal: Collected core from runner-7-1 and uploaded: s3://incidents/1945684321/runner-7-1-core.tar.gz. Also captured pinned heap -> s3://incidents/1945684321/heap-runner-7-1.txt.

Rafael SRE: Restarted the pod with REDWOOD_RUNTIME_DEBUG=1 and new runtime flag `kv_eviction_lock_strict=true`. Initial smoke looks promising, 5xx dropping to ~3% after 2m.

Maya Patel: Customer comms: ZephyrCorp support pinged. Tina, confirm that no customer data was exposed.

Tina P.: Confirmed: no data exfiltration. This is availability-only. Notifying Zephyr with mitigation steps and ETA for full fix.

Sania Iqbal: Root cause hypothesis: eviction race + large batched inference requests cause double-free in cache cleanup. Repro attempt in staging with batch=64 and persistent kv shows same crash. I have a local patch to gate frees behind ownership flag and add an atomic guard.

Rafael SRE: Good repro. Requesting a hotfix merge and a canary deploy to 3% traffic. Attach unit test demonstrating race.

Sania Iqbal: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/1259 - contains fix, regression test, and instrumentation to detect double-free attempts.

Maya Patel: Escalating to eng-runtime for expedited review. Rafael, can you schedule a canary?

Rafael SRE: Canary scheduled to runner-7-canary group (3% traffic) in eu-central-1. Monitoring for 15m.

obs-bot: Canary metrics: patched instances 5xx=0.1%, baseline 5xx=1.8%; latency p95 steady. No new OOMs observed on canary.

Maya Patel: Canary clean after 16m. Rolling patch to prod in staged waves. Keep alert thresholds tight.

Tina P.: Zephyr updated ticket: they see improved responses with fallback and appreciate the update. I've provided a postmortem follow-up timeline.

Rafael SRE: Immediate mitigations to keep in place: (1) gateway batch cap for rwx family, (2) route fallback for large-batch tenants, (3) cordon problematic nodes automatically when repeating cores observed.

Sania Iqbal: I'll take ownership of the code fix and unit tests. Rafael, please own infra controls and auto-cordon. Maya will handle customer comms and post-incident report.

Maya Patel: Creating follow-up ticket INC-1945684321 in tracker and requesting postmortem within 48h. Action items: add eviction race tests, add a runtime safety-check to avoid double-free, tune alerts to capture batch-size spikes correlated with errors, and revert temporary fallback once fully verified.

incident-bot: Incident marked mitigated by Maya Patel. Severity set P1 -> RCA required.

obs-bot: Timeline, logs, cores, and PR attached in incident archive: https://incidents.internal/1945684321.

Rafael SRE: Good job team. Closing page but keeping follow-up open until RCA complete.

Tina P.: Noted. Thanks everyone for fast coordination.

Maya Patel: Closing slack thread for live ops. Will post postmortem link here when ready.
